races.title: Boyle Sports Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: LORIKO tasted success 4 times over hurdles for his top yard during the summer, reaching a near-useful level in the process and having shaped much better than the margin of defeat would imply on chase debut 11 days ago, he looks to have been found an excellent opportunity quickly reverting back to smaller obstacles. Irish raider Combs comfortably rates the chief threat with first-time blinkers applied. LORIKO (FR) COMBS (IRE) SOME GOOD MEN GONE (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Loriko (1/3), Combs (5/2), Some Good Men Gone (33/1)

races.title: Boyle Sports Back Yourself Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: THE KALOOKI KID didn't go on from his return last season, but he reverts to hurdles from 11 lb below his chase mark and has had a breathing operation ahead of his reappearance. Representing a stable amongst the winners, he gets the vote ahead of Jericoacoara , who opened his account for his current yard when last seen in May. THE KALOOKI KID JERICOACOARA (FR) NOPRESENTLIKETIME (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Jericoacoara (10/11), Who's Going (4/1), Nopresentliketime (9/2), The Kalooki Kid (7/1), Shantwopointfive (20/1), Fine Thing (20/1)

races.title: Sebden Steel Celebrating 30 Years In Business Novices' Limited Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: SPADESTEP produced a laboured effort at Carlisle when last seen, but he was a winner first time back (over hurdles) last season and this could be the time to catch him, especially with his yard in red-hot form. Le Beau Madrik came off second best in a match race with Florida Dreams just over a fortnight ago and is now much worse off at the weights, but that experience shouldn't have been lost on him and it's reasonable to believe he can reverse the form. SPADESTEP (IRE) LE BEAU MADRIK (FR) FLORIDA DREAMS (IRE)
races.bettingForecast: Florida Dreams (10/11), Le Beau Madrik (9/4), Spadestep (5/1), Smart Decision (10/1)

races.title: Boyle Sports Now Open In Wetherby Introductory' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: VELVET OUTLAW is pretty hard to oppose after finishing runner-up in a bumper on Rules debut. Yashin may still possess enough ability to chase him home. VELVET OUTLAW (IRE) YASHIN (IRE) RECOBELLA (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Velvet Outlaw (4/7), Yashin (13/8), Recobella (20/1), Static Charm (33/1)

races.title: Boyle Sports Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: Likeable veteran TOMMY'S OSCAR looks the most solid option in a tricky race for betting purposes. Palamon is likely to have a say if on a going day, with similar comments applying to 3-time C&D winner Geryville . TOMMY'S OSCAR (IRE) PALAMON (IRE) GERYVILLE (FR)
races.bettingForecast: Tommy's Oscar (5/4), Palamon (6/4), The Bluesman (9/2), Gunsight Ridge (25/1), Geryville (25/1)

races.title: Colin Baldwin Memorial Handicap Hurdle
races.verdict: Hat-trick-seeking CENTURION'S SISTER could still be ahead of her mark and is taken to defy a rise in grade. Roarin' Success and Filibustering both look solid dangers in a tight handicap. CENTURION'S SISTER (IRE) ROARIN' SUCCESS FILIBUSTERING

races.title: Boyle Sports Conditional Jockeys' Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
races.verdict: SLANEY OPERA has made a positive start for his new trainer, scoring at Uttoxeter in October and beaten only by an improver over C&D last time, so he is taken to resume winning ways. Safe Destination returned to form when third to the selection on his reappearance and is the pick for second, ahead of Camarrate . SLANEY OPERA (IRE) SAFE DESTINATION CAMARRATE (IRE)
